nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.xnat_inputs¶

XNAT input mode for PESA-Fat (IA_PET_V5).

This module downloads the required DICOM resources from XNAT into the existing PESA-Fat DICOM layout so the rest of the pipeline (stage0_convert → stages 1-3) can run unchanged.

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.xnat_inputs.download_pesa_fat_dicoms_from_xnat(*, batch: str | None, subjects: Iterable[str], dicom_root: pathlib.Path, xnat_config_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, request: XnatPesaFatRequest | None = None) → dict[str, tuple[str, dict[str, pathlib.Path]]]¶

Download DICOMs from XNAT into dicom_root/<batch>/<subject>/<sequence>/.

If batch is None or “auto”, the batch is derived per subject from the XNAT experiment date.

Returns {subject: (batch, {sequence: local_dir})}.
